Ingredients.raw:
1 cup dried hibiscus flowers
8 quarts (2 gallons) water

Ingredients.formatted:
1 cup dried hibiscus flowers
8 quarts (2 gallons) water
1/4 tsp pure stevia extract

Directions.raw:
1. Fill infuser with hibiscus.
2. Heat 6 quarts water to boiling.
3. Steep 40 minutes.
4. Remove infuser.
5. Add stevia while warm and stir.
6. Pour into dispenser.
7. Add cold water to reach 2 gallons.
8. Chill and adjust sweetness to taste.
